baseline_optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW, betas(.9,.98), eps1e-8, weight_decay as recorded, 50-update completed-step warmup
epoch_definition: Actual examples presented divided by the fixed training-set size; include short tail batches and the documented zero-rate first update. CUDA capture warmup consumes no updates or examples.
evaluation_schedule: Every min(historical observation interval, one training epoch in updates); fixed across seeds and candidates. Report previous/first-success observation bracket.
limitations: Selected on seed 1. Seeds 0/2 are not yet trained for this new benchmark. Finer evaluation changes stopping resolution; historical epochs are reference measurements, not a completed three-seed baseline. Primary held-out split is validation; final test where present is auxiliary.
success_rule: Any single exhaustive primary held-out observation >=99% exact sequences. No delay or final-retention requirement. Stop at first observed crossing.
tier_note: Disjoint task membership frozen from historical seed-1 wall time including setup. These thresholds select tasks; they are not new per-run timeouts.
